## 3. Flagship Engineering Projects

### STRANGLER-IPU — Ingress Processing Unit Architecture & CXL Modeling
- **Category:** Computer Architecture / Near-Memory Systems / 6G Telecommunications
- **Architecture:** Near-memory hardware accelerator subsystem targeting 6G Sub-THz line-rate ingest (800 Gbps – 1.6 Tbps burst) and AI boundary computing; eliminates host DRAM memory-wall contention through decoupled front-end ingress offload.
- **Validation & Metrics:** Discrete-event simulation via SimPy (`sim/sweep_ipu_breakeven.py`, EXP-001) modeling asymmetric CXL 3.0/4.0 pooled memory fabrics; demonstrated 4.12× tail-latency reduction and 68% host memory bus contention relief.
- **Governance:** Formulated with formal RFCs (`ARCH-RFC-001/002/003`), invariant specifications (`INV-EPI-001`, `INV-MEM-001`), and self-compiling in-repo LaTeX technical reports.

### SPARK — Intelligent Fall Detection & Bio-Telemetry Wearable
- **Category:** Edge AI / Embedded Systems / Assistive Health Tech
- **Architecture:** Two-layer, on-device fall detection wearable for eldercare (Layer 1 ISR threshold gate at 200 Hz + Layer 2 TFLite Micro 1D CNN).
- **Hardware & Firmware:** ESP32-S3 microcontroller, MPU6050 6-DOF IMU, 18.5 KB INT8 quantized model (87.7% compression vs FP32) with 56 passing unit tests.
- **AI/ML:** 1D CNN trained under leakage-free subject-grouped split on SisFall (0.9185 AUC-ROC, 87.81% sensitivity).
- **Gateway & Explainability:** Edge gateway with local SHAP attribution across 4 distinct biomechanical fall profiles, automated clinical PDF generation, and Nepal cohort data collection campaign.

### Fuse AI Fellowship 14-Week Capstone & Pipelines
- **Week 14 (Capstone):** BiasAperture — Vision-model fairness & demographic disparity diagnostic suite.
- **Week 13:** Text-to-SQL Agentic Pipeline — 5-stage agentic LLM code generation pipeline achieving 100% benchmark execution accuracy.
- **Week 12:** Customer Churn & CLV Modeling with XGBoost, LightGBM, and Bayesian PyMC survival analysis (ROC-AUC 0.841).
- **Week 11:** Production PyTorch Deep Learning with DDP, mixed-precision (FP16), and TensorBoard profiling.
- **Week 10:** Multi-horizon time-series demand forecasting ensemble (AutoARIMA + Prophet + LightGBM, MASE 2.44).
- **Weeks 1–9:** Statistical foundations, feature engineering, unsupervised clustering, classification benchmarks, and regression pipelines.

### GCSBR — Gyroscopic Self-Balancing Robot
- **Category:** Robotics & Control Systems (BEI Minor Project)
- **Specs:** Dual-wheel inverted pendulum balancing robot using STM32/Arduino, MPU6050 complementary filter, PID closed-loop feedback control, and L298N dual H-bridge motor driver.

### Alpha — Android Engineering Super-App
- **Category:** Mobile & System Software
- **Stack:** Modern Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, Coroutines, Room DB, Target SDK 36).

### Nexus — Personal AI Operating System & Assistant
- **Category:** Full-Stack & Agentic AI
- **Stack:** FastAPI, WebSockets, Local Vector DB (ChromaDB), Ollama / OpenAI API orchestration.

### NovaOptimizer — High-Efficiency Windows Task Manager & System Optimizer
- **Category:** Desktop Systems Software & Kernel Utilities
- **Stack:** C# / .NET 10, WPF, Win32 NT Kernel APIs (`NtSetSystemInformation`), Windows 10/11.
- **Specs:** Native ~25 MB RAM footprint; undocumented kernel standby list & system working set purging; Turbo Boost profiles (Game, Work, Study with integrated Pomodoro focus timer); hung-process watchdog.

### Claude Desktop Multi-Profile & Autonomous Worker Fleet
- **Category:** Distributed Agentic Systems & Developer Ergonomics
- **Stack:** PowerShell 7, Windows Shell, FastAPI, SQLite WAL, Claude Desktop MCP, Docker.
- **Specs:** Automated user profile isolation and concurrent multi-window session routing; distributed task coordinator with atomic leasing and autonomous worker daemons.

### md2pdf — Desktop Markdown to PDF Converter
- **Category:** Desktop Productivity Utilities
- **Stack:** Python 3, Tkinter, Pandoc AST, wkhtmltopdf WebKit engine.
- **Specs:** Cross-platform GUI editor with adjustable print margins, UTF-8 preservation, and system PATH dependency auto-discovery.
